name: atannex/laravel-flutter-bridge
description: Enterprise-grade Laravel bridge for Flutter applications: Sanctum auth with rotating refresh tokens, Laravel Fortify account features over bearer tokens, connection sessions & remote sign-out, app keys with version policy, Reverb broadcasting, device registration, and Dart code generation.

suggest.laravel/sanctum: Required for default mobile token authentication (^3.0|^4.0)
suggest.laravel/reverb: Required for modern WebSockets / real-time broadcasting (^1.0)
suggest.laravel/fortify: Reuse Fortify's sign-in, sign-up, password reset, email verification, profile, password, two-factor and passkey management on the bridge (^1.41)
suggest.laravel/passkeys: Manage passkeys from the app through Fortify's passkeys feature (^0.2)
